no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-imaging device and AI-software company. Products are FDA-cleared, commercially marketed X-ray hardware (Nanox.ARC, Nanox.ARC X) and SaMD AI tools (Nanox.AI suite). No proprietary drug candidates and no active P1/P2/P3 trials with Nano-X as lead sponsor on ClinicalTrials.gov.
